profile.name: Ravi Ardhana
profile.headline: A Passionate
profile.about: I am a dedicated and results-driven software developer with a strong foundation in modern web engineering, algorithms, and system programming. Driven by transforming complex problem statements into elegant, high-performance digital experiences. Constantly mastering new concepts through structured skill roadmaps and daily problem solving.

topics.title: Event Loop, Microtasks & Web Workers
topics.concept: Concurrency model, Call Stack, Task Queue vs Microtask Queue, requestAnimationFrame, and background Web Workers for CPU-heavy tasks.
topics.notes: Build a simulation or small visualizer for the call stack and microtask queue.

topics.title: Asyncio & Async Iterators
topics.concept: Coroutines, event loops, asyncio.gather, TaskGroups in Python 3.11+, and non-blocking network I/O pipelines.
topics.notes: Refactor web scraper to use asyncio and aiohttp for 10x throughput.

topics.title: Segment Trees & Lazy Propagation
topics.concept: Range sum/minimum queries in O(log n), dynamic point and range updates with lazy propagation flags.
topics.notes: Prepare for hard LeetCode range query and interval problems.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming: Bitmasking & Digit DP
topics.concept: Subset representation using bitmasks, Hamiltonian paths, TSP state compression, and digit DP counting.
topics.notes: Solve 5 Bitmask DP LeetCode Hard problems.

topics.title: Container Queries & Custom Plugins
topics.concept: @container queries, fluid typography, dark mode CSS variables architecture, and custom Tailwind utility plugins.
topics.notes: Implemented successfully in the latest dashboard component cards.

topics.title: B-Tree Indexes & EXPLAIN Query Optimization
topics.concept: Covering indexes, composite index column ordering, preventing full table scans in large datasets, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution trees.
topics.notes: Profile slow queries on sample e-commerce database.

topics.title: Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) & ARIA Patterns
topics.concept: Screen reader live regions, focus trap in modals, contrast ratios, and accessible rich internet applications (ARIA).
topics.notes: Audit portfolio and dashboard with axe-core.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.approach: Track minimum price seen so far and calculate max potential profit at each step in O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.approach: Two-pass prefix and suffix product accumulation in result array without using division operator.

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring
problems.approach: Dynamic sliding window with frequency map and match counter. Contract window when valid.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.approach: Sort array, fix one element and use two pointers to find pairs summing to -nums[i]. Skip duplicates.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.approach: Stack of open brackets matched against closed brackets using hash map in O(n) time.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.approach: Two pointers at edges; move the pointer with the shorter line inwards greedily to seek larger areas.

problems.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problems.approach: Sliding window tracking max frequency count. Slide window when window length - maxFreq > k.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.approach: Two pointers from ends skipping non-alphanumeric chars with case insensitivity.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.approach: Sliding window with hash map storing last seen index of each character.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.approach: Two pointers with left_max and right_max bounds in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.approach: Hash map using character count tuple (or sorted string) as key grouping anagram lists.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.approach: One-pass hash map storing value to index mapping to check target - current.

problems.title: Daily Temperatures
problems.approach: Monotonic decreasing stack storing indices of temperatures.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.approach: Monotonic increasing stack storing pair of index and height. Pop and compute areas on drops.

problems.title: Binary Search
problems.approach: Standard classic binary search with mid = left + (right - left) // 2.

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.approach: Treat 2D m x n matrix as 1D virtual sorted array of size m*n; binary search in O(log(mn)).

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.approach: Binary search comparing mid element with right boundary to locate inflection point.

problems.title: Reverse Linked List
problems.approach: Iterative three-pointer approach (prev, curr, next) in O(n) time and O(1) space.

problems.title: Linked List Cycle
problems.approach: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare two-pointer cycle detection.

problems.title: Reorder List
problems.approach: Find middle of list, reverse second half, merge first half and reversed second half.

problems.title: Invert Binary Tree
problems.approach: Recursive depth-first traversal swapping left and right child nodes.

problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.approach: DFS post-order returning 1 + max(leftDepth, rightDepth).

problems.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problems.approach: BFS level-by-level traversal using deque with queue size snapshot.

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.approach: In-order traversal verifying strictly increasing values, or DFS with min/max valid bounds.

problems.title: Number of Islands
problems.approach: BFS/DFS flood-fill algorithm sinking visited '1's into '0's.

problems.title: Clone Graph
problems.approach: DFS traversal using hash map to map original nodes to their cloned counterparts.

problems.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
problems.approach: Multi-source BFS from coastal boundary cells inward; intersect reachable cell sets.

problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.approach: Kahn's Algorithm topological sort with in-degree array, checking for DAG cycles.

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.approach: Bottom-up dynamic programming Fibonacci sequence in O(n) time, O(1) space.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.approach: DP recurrence rob = max(nums[i] + rob1, rob2) tracking two state variables.

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.approach: Bottom-up 1D DP array of size amount + 1 initialized to infinity. dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c]).

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.approach: Patience sorting with binary search (bisect_left) in tails array in O(n log n) time.

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence
problems.approach: 2D DP grid matching characters diagonally or taking max of adjacent cells.

problems.title: Maximum Subarray
problems.approach: Kadane's algorithm resetting running sum when negative in O(n) time.

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.approach: Hash set comparison length vs array length in O(n) time.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.approach: Character count array / hash map comparison.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.approach: Bucket sort with frequency array of lists to achieve linear O(n) time.

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.approach: Two balanced heaps: max-heap for small half and min-heap for large half.

problems.title: Subsets
problems.approach: Recursive backtracking choosing to include or exclude each element.

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.approach: Backtracking tree allowing reuse of same candidate until sum exceeds target.

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.approach: Row-by-row placement tracking occupied columns and positive/negative diagonals with sets.

problems.title: Number of 1 Bits
problems.approach: Brian Kernighan's bit hack: n &= (n - 1) to clear lowest set bit.

problems.title: Counting Bits
problems.approach: DP with bit shifting: dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1) in linear O(n) time.

problems.title: Single Number
problems.approach: XOR all numbers together; duplicate pairs cancel to 0 leaving unique number.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.approach: Sum formula n*(n+1)//2 minus array sum or XOR approach.

problems.title: Insert Interval
problems.approach: Three-phase linear scan: add non-overlapping left, merge overlapping, add non-overlapping right.

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.approach: Sort intervals by start time and merge greedily if current start <= previous end.

problems.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problems.approach: Greedy interval scheduling: sort by end times and count non-conflicting intervals.
